messages:
sara: Quick team update  starting today all SDK PRs that touch public types or defaults must include: 1) a runnable example in at least two languages (JS or Python required), 2) a short migration snippet if behavior changed, and 3) a docs section in PR describing customer impact. This becomes a blocker in CI via docs-lint. Please review: https://redwood.internal/docs/docs-gated-release
lee: Oof, mandatory examples could slow small fix PRs. Any exemptions?
sara: Minor non-public cosmetic changes are exempt. The CI rule detects changed files under packages/*/public-api or reference/* and will only block when public surface is modified.
morgan: What qualifies as a "runnable example"? Snippets are often flaky in tests.
sara: Runnable = a small snippet that can be executed against the SDK canary and verifies the new behavior. We provide a test harness (examples-runner) so examples are executed in CI. Example:```
# JS example for new streaming default
import Redwood from 'redwood';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.TEST_API_KEY });
(async () => {
  const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1.0', prompt: 'hello', stream: true });
  console.log(resp.status); // should be 200
})();
```
docs-bot: Reminder: new docs-lint rule: "examples-present" will surface a checklist in PRs. Docs template: https://redwood.internal/templates/sdk-example.md
ci-bot: Canary job scheduled: examples-runner-canary at 2025-04-10T09:00Z. Failing examples will mark PR with "examples-failed" label.
harry: For breaking behavioral changes, are we requiring a feature-flag guard?
sara: Yes. All runtime-breaking behavior toggles must be behind a feature flag for at least one release cycle (two weeks of canary). The PR must include how to opt-in/out and a migration snippet.
lee: How will we surface this to customers? Pan-organization comms?
sara: Docs will auto-generate a "migration snippets" page per release. We'll also add release notes and an in-console banner for changes that affect defaults. Enterprise customers will get CSM outreach for high-impact changes.
morgan: Can the examples-runner create flakiness noise? We should allow recorded HTTP fixtures for slow external calls.
sara: Agreed. Examples-runner supports replay fixtures and local mocks. Add a note in the example header if fixtures are used.
docs-bot: Also adding a docs badge to the SDK package README when examples are present: [examples checked].
ci-bot: Enforcing: PRs touching public surface without examples will fail docs-lint check. Jobs: redwood/examples-checker, redwood/docs-lint.
sara: Thanks all 4dd. I'll post the updated PR template and a short FAQ in #devex. If you need help converting older PRs, ping me and we can run a small migration sprint.
